method: axe-core automated WCAG A/AA plus best-practice scan, 390 and 1440px, reduced motion, no form interactions or submissions
limitations: Automated scans do not establish full WCAG conformance or keyboard usability.
Cross-origin form content may be incomplete or inaccessible to axe; host page findings remain applicable.
Contrast diagnostics must be checked against rendered imagery, gradients, opacity, and element state.

assessment.keyboardFlow: Not established by this automated scan; no form submission, menu, or modal interactions were performed.
assessment.crossOriginFrames: Murrieta iframe returned frame-tested incomplete at both widths; embedded contents are not cleared by this audit.

groups.finding: Sage #7cb342 on white = 2.5:1; sage on cream = 2.35:1; white on sage = 2.5:1; article link sage-dark #689f38 on white = 3.17:1. These regular-size text/button labels require 4.5:1.
groups.action: Use a darker accessible text/action color for these solid-background uses; keep decorative/gradient use separate.

groups.category: Cookie consent, shared across all scans
groups.finding: Accept white text on green #00a63e measures 3.21:1. Banner explanatory content is outside a landmark (axe best-practice region warning).
groups.action: Use an adequate contrast action color and expose the nonmodal consent notice as an appropriately named region.

groups.finding: Quote form H3 follows page H1 without H2 on both Palm Desert hubs and Murrieta; Local Climate H4 skips H3 on Murrieta.
groups.action: Use heading levels that match the surrounding outline, retaining visual styling.

groups.finding: Desktop sidebar aside is a complementary landmark nested within main; axe reports landmark-complementary-is-top-level.
groups.action: Review whether the article tools need a separate landmark; retain the labeled TOC navigation either way.

groups.category: Manual contrast diagnostics, not established failures
sources: Multiple image, gradient, and translucent backgrounds
groups.finding: Axe reports incomplete color-contrast cases on every route; automated background determination was insufficient.
groups.action: Review rendered backgrounds and element state visually before deciding on changes.
